name: axHub users help
description: axHub users's Help mode entries (help@1), moved from the axHub web app's help when it folded into the console.
author: Brett

entries.title: Users
entries.text: Who can sign in to the hub, their role and their permissions.

entries.title: Temporary password
entries.text: A password they must change the first time they sign in.

entries.title: Save name and email
entries.text: Saves the user's name and email.

entries.title: Change role
entries.text: Gives the user another role (admin, member…).

entries.title: Another permission
entries.text: Adds a permission to this user.

entries.title: Save permissions
entries.text: Saves what this user may do.

entries.title: Set a temporary password
entries.text: Gives the user a password they must change on first sign-in.
